title: TAT-3561 Auto Close RoE sign toggle
description: Proves the Auto Close TP/SL %RoE +/− badges: defaults (+ TP / − SL), toggle, sign-aware empty placeholders, signed RoE recomputing the trigger price, preset sign snap, and existing side-of-current validation still blocking an invalid opposite-sign order on a new long.

market.description: Perps market to open the Auto Close sheet from.

proofTargets.claim: Tapping the TP badge flips + to - and back
Tapping the SL badge flips - to +
TP empty placeholder reads % Loss when the badge is - and % Profit when +
SL empty placeholder reads % Gain when the badge is +
TP +25% preset fills a positive RoE and a trigger price; toggling to - keeps the magnitude and recomputes the trigger
SL -5% preset fills a negative RoE; toggling to + keeps the magnitude and recomputes the trigger
A negative TP RoE on a new long is still blocked by existing take-profit side-of-current validation
A positive SL RoE on a new long is still blocked by existing stop-loss side-of-current validation
+ badge uses success color and - badge uses error color on TP
+ badge uses success color and - badge uses error color on SL
